correctness.rationale: The unimodular coordinate change Z=omega-(b-1)x is conserved, and conditional fiber dynamics are x->bx+Z with Haar mixing. Pairwise positions X_s,X_t come from an integer torus matrix of nonzero determinant (b^t-b^s)/(b-1), giving exactly product Haar (not only pairwise digit independence). For q|b the image of any cell under slope b covers the whole circle b/q integer times with uniform pushforward, proving conditional and unconditional iid words. For q∤b, the long-lag covariance is Var_Z[p_Z] by fiber mixing, where p_Z=∫1_{I_j}(x)1_{I_k}(bx+Z)dx. Fourier in Z gives sum_{m!=0} sin²(πm/q)sin²(π bm/q)/(π⁴b²m⁴), positive by m=1; Parseval and the Bernoulli-fourth Fourier series give the exact rational expression. The conditional word indicator has variation <=2(b+2), bounding transfer-operator grid averaging error by 2(b+2)b^{-n}. Independently verified the B4 formula against a separate 18,000-frequency positive Fourier sum for 108 parameter pairs, and the binary odd-b constant 1/(48b²). Finite checks confirm but do not prove the full parameter theorem.
